summary: Iteration 38 - Verified RBAC hardening + Sankey mock removal on Intercloud portal. Backend: 62/62 pytest PASS covering (a) 5 destructive user-management endpoints -> 403 for finance/sales/support/ticket_only (20 combos), (b) finance can GET 9 finance/asset/service/bank endpoints (200), (c) support can GET 9 mikrotik/noc/diagnostics/proxmox/products/services/system endpoints (200), (d) cross-role restrictions still 403 (5 combos), (e) sankey returns live:false + empty flows (no mock 203.0.113/'VM Web Cluster'), (f) admin still 200 on all 18 read endpoints. Frontend: finance menu opens with real revenue data (Rp 137.424.000, Rp 122.674.000 net profit), no infinite loading; /admin/users for finance shows 464 rows with data-testid actions-restricted-<email> on ALL 464 rows and NO new-user-btn; for admin new-user-btn is present and 0 restricted spans; support role reaches /admin/noc + /admin/mikrotik without 403; NetflowSankey renders data-testid='sankey-empty' with 'Belum ada data trafik live' and no dummy IPs. One critical bug found and worked around at data level: seeded finance user was missing created_at causing /api/portal/auth/me to 500 (Pydantic ResponseValidationError). Patched the row so testing could complete; underlying issue must be fixed by main agent (either backfill user fields OR make /auth/me tolerant to missing created_at).

critical.issue: Returns 500 ResponseValidationError when a users doc lacks created_at (or has it as datetime object, not ISO string). Seeded finance@intercloud-digital.com user hit this - blocks entire finance-role UI (session appears logged out after login because /auth/me fails).

integration_issues.issue: If /auth/me 500s (see backend critical above), SPA silently redirects to /portal/login making it look like login failed. UX should surface the error instead of forcing logout.

action_items: Fix /api/portal/auth/me: either normalize created_at (ensure ISO string when read from DB) OR make the response model tolerant (Optional[str] with default). Backfill users collection so every doc has created_at as ISO8601 string. Root cause: finance@intercloud-digital.com was inserted directly into Mongo without going through the admin create-user path, so it lacked created_at + other profile fields.

Consider adding a lightweight seed/repair migration that upserts standard fields (created_at, is_active, totp_enabled, feature_flags, menu_keys) for any legacy user document to prevent similar 500s across other endpoints (get_bank_accounts / admin/users listing worked because they don't read created_at, but /auth/me does).
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint destructive user-mgmt correctly retained get_current_admin (admin_create_user L2454, admin_update_user L2499, admin_delete_user L2539, admin_reset_2fa L617, admin_reset_user_password L6466). Verified by 20 parametrized 403 assertions.

noc_netflow_sankey (L7487-7523) no longer contains mock FLOWS - agg is built strictly from live MikroTik torch samples; returns live:false + flows:[] when no device sampled. UI NetflowSankey.jsx has no dummy IP strings.
AdminUsers.jsx correctly gates by isAdmin = me?.role==='admin'; renders Admin only for staff roles and hides new-user-btn.
portal/routes.py still ~10.9k lines (previously flagged) - continuing recommendation to modularize.
conftest.py auto-resets sales/support/ticket_only passwords each session to Sales2026!/Support2026!/Ticket2026! - important to know for future test agents (not StaffTest2026!).
Users collection has legacy documents missing required profile fields (finance user only had 7 keys). Add a data-integrity check or migration.

rca_of_the_issue: Bug: /api/portal/auth/me returns 500 for finance role. Reproduction: (1) POST /api/portal/auth/login with finance creds -> 200 + token. (2) GET /api/portal/auth/me with Bearer token -> 500 'Internal Server Error'. Backend logs: fastapi.exceptions.ResponseValidationError: 1 validation errors: {'type': 'missing', 'loc': ('response', 'created_at')} (or 'string_type' when created_at is a datetime not string). Root cause: finance@intercloud-digital.com was inserted directly into Mongo without created_at (only 7 keys: _id, email, is_active, name, password_hash, role, totp_enabled). The UserOut response model requires created_at: str. Mitigation applied by tester: db.users.update_one({'email':'finance@...'}, {'$set':{'created_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}}). Permanent fix (main agent): (a) make the response model tolerant OR (b) always coerce datetime->isoformat in _user_public serialization OR (c) migration to backfill created_at for all legacy user docs.
